CREATE TABLE lateral_values_input(a integer PRIMARY KEY)
INSERT INTO lateral_values_input VALUES (1),(3)
CREATE VIEW lateral_values_view AS SELECT t.a,v.x FROM lateral_values_input t,LATERAL (VALUES (t.a),(t.a*10)) v(x)
SELECT a,x FROM lateral_values_view ORDER BY 1,2
CREATE FUNCTION lateral_values_routine(n integer) RETURNS TABLE(x integer) LANGUAGE SQL AS 'SELECT v.x FROM (VALUES (n),(n*10)) v(x) ORDER BY v.x'
SELECT * FROM lateral_values_routine(7)
SELECT t.a,r.x FROM lateral_values_input t CROSS JOIN LATERAL lateral_values_routine(t.a) r ORDER BY 1,2
